uncited: **Compute Bounding Box and Centroid:** Iterate through all points in the point cloud.
Record the maximum ($w_{max}$) and minimum ($w_{min}$) coordinate values for each dimension ($x, y, z$).
**Scale the Model:** Calculate the scaling factor $s$ to fit the model in a cubic volume of side 1024.
**Apply Rotation:** Apply a rigid rotation to the spatial coordinates using a rotation matrix $R$ calculated from the user-defined yaw and pitch angles.
**Apply Panning:** If user interaction includes panning, add shift values $pan_x$ and $pan_y$ to the $x$ and $y$ coordinates respectively.
**Generate Projections:** Define a bounding cube around the object.
Project the voxelized point cloud orthographically onto the 6 faces of the cube.
**Compute Quality Metrics:** Apply 2D image metrics to each pair of projected reference and distorted images.
